```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#
library(flexdashboard)
library(rsconnect)
library(knitr)
library(shiny)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(DT)
library(patchwork)
#
```

```{R}
#Import Data

setwd("C:/Users/User/OneDrive - University of Ghana/moyussif@NMIMR/NMIMR/4Official/mod_r")

 LFdata <- read_excel("LF_July_22.xlsx")

df <- LFdata

# Create Age groups
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Age_group = case_when(
      age < 10 ~ "<10",
      age >=10 & age <=19 ~ "10-19",
      age >=20 & age <=29 ~ "20-29",
      age >=30 & age <=40 ~ "30-40",
      age >40 ~ ">40",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

```

# Select Indicators

```{r}
selectInput(
  "site",
  "Site",
  choices = c("All", sort(unique(df$site))),
  selected = "All"
)

selectInput(
  "sex",
  "Sex",
  choices = c("All", sort(unique(df$sex))),
  selected = "All"
)

selectInput(
  "age",
  "Age Group",
  choices = c("All", sort(unique(df$Age_group))),
  selected = "All"
)

```

```{r}
filtered <- reactive({

x <- df

if(input$site!="All")
  x <- filter(x, site==input$site)

if(input$sex!="All")
  x <- filter(x, sex==input$sex)

if(input$age!="All")
  x <- filter(x, Age_group==input$age)

x

})

```

# Total-count

### Participants

```{r}
renderValueBox({

valueBox(

value = nrow(filtered()),

caption = "Participants",

icon = "fa-users",

color = "primary"

)

})

```

### Malaria Positive

```{r}
renderValueBox({

n <- filtered() %>%
  summarise(n=sum(malaria_t_results=="Positive",na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  pull()

valueBox(n,"Malaria Positive","fa-virus","danger")

})

```

### FTS Positive

```{r}
renderValueBox({

n <- filtered() %>%
  summarise(n=sum(fts_test_result=="Positive",na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  pull()

valueBox(n,"FTS Positive","fa-vial","success")

})

```

# Basic Summary

### Basic Summary

```{r}
render_gt({

filtered() %>%

tbl_summary(

include=c(consent,site),

statistic=all_categorical()~"{n} ({p}%)",

missing="ifany"

) %>%

bold_labels() %>%

italicize_levels() %>%

modify_caption("**Basic Summary**") %>%

as_gt()

})

```

### Malaria Summary

```{r}
render_gt({

filtered() %>%

tbl_summary(

include=c(malaria_test_done,
          malaria_t_results),

statistic=all_categorical()~"{n} ({p}%)"

) %>%

bold_labels() %>%

italicize_levels() %>%

modify_caption("**Malaria Results**") %>%

as_gt()

})

```

### FTS Summary


# Prevalence

### Interactive Prevalence

```{r}
renderPlotly({

prev <- filtered() %>%

group_by(site,
         sex,
         Age_group) %>%

summarise(

Prev=
mean(
fts_test_result=="Positive",
na.rm=TRUE
)*100,

.groups="drop"

)

p <- ggplot(
  prev,
  aes(
    Age_group,
    Prev,
    fill = sex,
    text = paste(
      "Age:", Age_group,
      "<br>Sex:", sex,
      "<br>Prev:", round(Prev, 1), "%"
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Male" = "#1f77b4",    # blue
    "Female" = "#e63946"   # red
  )) +
  facet_wrap(~site) +
  theme_bw()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
})

```

# Community Results

### Community Results

```{r}
renderDT({

community_table <-

filtered() %>%

group_by(

site,

keea_communities,

keea_facilities,

gomoa_west_communities,

gomoa_west_facilities

)%>%

summarise(

Malaria_Tested=n(),

Malaria_Positive=sum(
malaria_t_results=="Positive",
na.rm=TRUE
),

FTS_Tested=sum(!is.na(
fts_test_result
)),

FTS_Positive=sum(
fts_test_result=="Positive",
na.rm=TRUE
),

.groups="drop"

)

datatable(

community_table,

filter="top",

extensions="Buttons",

options=list(

pageLength=15,

dom="Bfrtip",

buttons=c(

"copy",

"csv",

"excel",

"pdf",

"print"

)

)

)

})


```
